text:
Which statement about the Periodic Table is correct?
A
Elements with the highest atomic number in each period are metallic.
B
Elements with the lowest group numbers are non-metals.
C
Elements with similar chemical properties are placed in groups.
D
Elements with similar physical properties are placed in periods.

options.label: A
options.text: Elements with the highest atomic number in each period are metallic.

options.label: B
options.text: Elements with the lowest group numbers are non-metals.

options.label: C
options.text: Elements with similar chemical properties are placed in groups.

options.label: D
options.text: Elements with similar physical properties are placed in periods.
